_what: Every unverified-output residue finding present in the outgoing documents on the day lint_submission_residue.py was written (2026-08-28, AUT-PROP-032). Anything NOT in this list fails the build the moment it is written.
_why_a_baseline_and_not_a_wall: The lint_citations precedent, for the same reason: failing the build on findings that already exist produces a red gate the next session switches off, which is worse than no gate. THE BASELINE IS THE FINDING — it names, for the first time, exactly which outgoing document carries which unfilled slot. The count is meant to FALL.
\u26d4_this_is_not_an_amnesty: A row here says a human read the string and decided it may stand FOR NOW. It does not say the document is ready to send. Nine of these fifteen are the SAME slot — a submission date the repository cannot supply and must not invent — and every one of them still has to be filled or cut before its letter goes to an editor.
\u2b50_two_rows_are_fixable_today_and_ar: nr4a3-fusion-transcriptional-output-cover-letter.md's [ORCID] is a fact this repository already holds (CITATION.cff and .zenodo.json), and nr4a3-fusion-transcriptional-output-SI.md's [] is an empty cell in a column every other row fills. Neither was changed by the cycle that wrote this gate, because a gate's author editing the documents it grades is the shape amendment_guard.py exists to catch; both are reported to the owner instead.
_key: file|rule|matched text — never a line number. A baseline keyed to a line is amnesty for whatever drifts onto that line.

entries.why: ⚠ A REAL HOLE, NOT A CONVENTION. The NDRG2 row's driver column is `[]` where every other row of that table names one (`NR4A3 (native)`, `EWSR1::NR4A3`). It renders as a literal `[]` in the built SI. If the intended meaning is 'no driver established for this class-D association', the cell must say so; if a value was dropped, it must be restored. Left as a finding for the document's owner rather than guessed at by the gate's author.

'Draft (2026-06). Authors/affiliations TBD.' — an unfilled author block in a manuscript the publications graph points a publication endpoint at. The document states its own draft status, so nothing here is dishonest; the TBD is nevertheless exactly the placeholder class that must not reach a submission portal, and it stays a finding until the block is filled.

'**Author:** [Name], Independent researcher, [City, Country]' in a document whose own banner reads 'DRAFT v0.1 — full prose, pre-clinician-review, not for submission'. The banner is the reason this is baselined rather than a build failure; the slot is still a slot.
The second half of the same unfilled author block. Recorded as its own row because the key is the matched TEXT: filling one slot and not the other must leave the gate red on the one still open.
'Draft manuscript (2026-06). Authors/affiliations TBD.' — the same unfilled author block as the neoantigen paper, in the roadmap manuscript PUB-EMC-PROGRAM points at.
